results.description:
College lovers torn apart by a family feud get a second chance in the board room in this contemporary romance by a USA Today–bestselling author.
Rugged oil tycoon Broderick has avoided temptation for years. But an abandoned baby forces him back into his ex-lover's world. He needs Glenna. For the child, for himself . . . for untangling the ties that bind their families. For discovering who the baby's father really is. But will their passion survive the truth?
Praise for The Baby Claim
"The longing and desire between Broderick and Glenna are apparent to readers as they feel the emotions vibrating between them." —Romance Reviews Today
"If you love a strong, sexy hero and equally strong sexy heroine, a second chance, strong family ties, sweet and steamy romance and a nice touch of mystery, then The Baby Claim is what you want." —Fresh Fiction
